description: This file defines a base class for testing pluggable queue balancer behavior in Orleans streaming tests. It includes test setup, a test method to verify proper queue balancing, and a nested configurator class for dependency injection.

classes.name: PluggableQueueBalancerTestBase
classes.description: A base class for tests involving pluggable queue balancers in Orleans streaming.

classes.name: SiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: A configurator class for setting up silo services to include a test implementation of a queue balancer.

methods.name: ShouldUseInjectedQueueBalancerAndBalanceCorrectly
methods.description: Runs a test to verify that the injected queue balancer balances responsibilities correctly across silos.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the silo host builder to register the test queue balancer implementation.

methods.name: CheckLeases
methods.description: Checks the lease responsibilities across silos to confirm correct balancing.
